biggest_catch: Only Costco's own price drops count — Costco never matches Amazon, Walmart, or any competitor's price.
catches: 30-day window from purchase date is strict (discretionary day 31-33 exceptions are not guaranteed).
Only Costco's own lower price qualifies; competitor prices are explicitly excluded.
Resellers are excluded from price adjustments entirely.
Online vs. warehouse are separate: request online orders online, warehouse purchases at the membership counter.
Item must be in stock at the lower price; gold bars, bullion, and silver coins are excluded.

c1.evidence: Costco customer-service official article (customerservice.costco.com, linked by clark.com): 30-day price adjustment on Costco.com orders; priceva.com (2026), dealnews.com, groupon.com, krazycouponlady.com document warehouse + online flows

c2.evidence: Concrete: refund of price difference to original payment method within 30 days; no need to bring the item back; purchase history tracked on membership

c3.evidence: No fee beyond the Costco membership itself.

c4.evidence: Concrete: groupon example — $799 adjusted to $699 = $100 back (example-based); typical example range $10-$100

eligibility: Costco members; non-reseller purchases within 30 days; exact same item
maximize: Make Costco the place you buy anything whose price fluctuates — electronics, appliances, big-ticket items — because you get 30 days of built-in price insurance no competitor offers. Set a calendar reminder for day 28 after every big Costco purchase to check the current price; if it dropped, claim the difference at the membership counter or through the online form. No receipt needed — your membership purchase history does the work, and you don't even have to bring the item back. Pair this with the Costco app's digital receipts so the check takes seconds.
notes: Savings, not income: payout fields = price difference refunded (example-based, flagged). Terms from Costco's official customer-service article + 2026 coverage. Distinct from Target/Best Buy routes: own-price adjustment only, membership required.
payout_quote: If an item you purchased goes on sale within that timeframe, you can request a refund of the price difference. For online orders, submit a request through Costco's customer service website. For in-store purchases, visit the returns counter at the warehouse.

repeatable.cadence: Repeatable within the 30-day window on every purchase — claim the adjustment whenever Costco's own price drops on something you bought.

s3.note: Refund to original payment method at counter or via online form.

s4.note: Concrete terms; example $100 adjustment documented by groupon.

s6.note: 5 steps: buy, track price, request, verify, get refund.

steps: Buy an item from a Costco warehouse or Costco.com
Watch the price for 30 days after purchase
If Costco drops the price, submit the online adjustment form (online orders) or visit the warehouse membership counter (in-store purchases)
Staff verify your membership purchase history — no receipt or return needed
Receive the price difference refunded to your original payment method
timing: Refund processed at request (counter) or after online form submission
who_pays: Nobody pays you — Costco refunds the difference to your original payment method when its own price drops. It's savings, not income.
who_qualifies: Costco members (membership required) making non-reseller purchases within 30 days; the exact same item at a lower Costco price.
work_available: Costco's price-adjustment policy is active — 30 days from purchase.
what_gets_accepted: Only Costco's own lower price qualifies — competitor prices are explicitly excluded. The item must be the exact same and in stock at the lower price; resellers are excluded entirely, as are gold bars, bullion, and silver coins.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fee beyond your Costco membership ($65/yr Gold Star). Unpaid time goes to noticing the price drop and requesting the adjustment at the counter or via the online form.
when_cash_arrives: No cash arrives — the difference is refunded to your original payment method when you request it at the membership counter (warehouse purchases) or through the online form (online orders).
